recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆巨核細胞，細胞偏小，核為單一緻密圓形、不分葉，周圍有粉紫色細顆粒狀細胞質，並有不規則邊緣；與旁邊的小淋巴球相比體積只有數倍大，這種「小型單圓核巨核細胞」是 del(5q) MDS 的特徵。
features: Megakaryocyte smaller than normal, a few times the size of adjacent lymphocytes
Single round, non-lobated, dense nucleus positioned eccentrically
Moderate pink-purple finely granular cytoplasm with irregular, ruffled borders
Background small dark lymphoid/erythroid cells and red cells; limited image resolution
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a small megakaryocyte with a single round, dense, non-lobated nucleus and a moderate rim of finely granular pink-purple cytoplasm with irregular borders. The granular cytoplasm indicates cytoplasmic maturation despite the absent nuclear lobation. Image resolution limits fine chromatin detail. Findings are consistent with a hypolobated/mononuclear megakaryocyte as seen in myelodysplastic neoplasm with isolated del(5q).

ddx.vs: True micromegakaryocytes are near lymphocyte size with scant cytoplasm, whereas 5q- megakaryocytes are larger with more cytoplasm; both are dysplastic and require cytogenetics.
Immature forms have deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm with blebs, not the pink granular cytoplasm seen here.
Plasma cells have deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin, without platelet-type azurophilic granules.
